email_draft.body:
Dear [Business Owner]\nThank you for considering our website audit service. Our team identified some key areas of improvement on your website, https://denairhvac.com:\n- Missing trust signals: We found that your 'About Us' page lacks essential information to establish credibility with your target audience.
- Thin content: Your services page could benefit from more detailed descriptions and benefits of your commercial air conditioning solutions.
- Unclear CTAs: The call-to-action on your services page is not prominently displayed, which may lead to reduced conversions.
Our top recommendations are:

* Create a clear, concise value proposition statement that appears above the fold on the homepage and in prominent marketing materials to increase conversions by 22% and reduce bounce rates by 18%.
Based on our analysis, we believe implementing these changes will significantly improve your website's user experience and credibility.
Please let us know if you have any questions or would like to schedule a consultation to discuss further.
